purpose: Name the palette-fade progress counter shared by the transition driver and palette convergence loop.

owner.increment: Increment it once after each VBlank-paced palette update at 0x001B2770.
owner.loop: Run the update loop for 47 iterations.

consumer.name: Render_ConvergePaletteWordsByProgress
consumer.operation: Load the current step counter as the per-palette-word convergence count while moving the 64 working palette words toward the target.

conclusion: FFEFF6 is the 16-bit palette-transition step counter, not palette data or a scene-resource gate.
